key_insight: TrialDesignBench reveals a gap between frontier LLMs and expert-validated, contemporary standards for early-phase oncology trial design.
clinical_relevance: The benchmark could support evaluation of AI-assisted dose-finding trial design as regulatory expectations evolve, including under FDA’s Project Optimus.
method: Formalized expert design decisions to create expert-validated reference designs.
Evaluated five frontier LLMs and tested contributions of missing design information and structured reasoning.
evidence_signal: No evaluated LLM matched the reference standard; supplying latent design determinants and structured decision-tree reasoning improved class-wise balanced accuracy by 0.22 and 0.24, respectively.
watch_item: Benchmark performance does not establish safety or effectiveness for prospective trial design; expert oversight remains essential.
paper_title: TrialDesignBench: Benchmarking Language Models for Phase-I Trial Design Against Clinical Knowledge
